pages.text: Craft two leaves, an empty compatible vessel and a water bucket for up to 100 mB of juice. Choose a shot glass for a small serving or combine several batches in a larger vessel.

pages.title: Make a Batch
pages.text: For a larger batch use seven leaves in the water-filled mash tub. Ferment it and distill once for mezcal, twice for blanco tequila. Age the blanco in a barrel for reposado. See $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/brewing_examples)batch worked examples$(/l).
